name: Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics Ltd.
summary: Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics Ltd. designs, develops, and manufactures a diverse range of precision optical and mechatronics solutions, scientific instruments, and devices. The company's primary products include optical components, optical systems, opto-mechanical systems, laser systems, educational kits, imaging and measuring instruments, spectroscopy equipment, analytical instruments, laboratory equipment, physics lab equipment, and linear and rotation stages, including motorized variants. Holmarc Opto-Mechatronics serves target markets such as research laboratories, educational institutions, and industrial automation, with applications spanning scientific research, space science, nuclear research, food and agricultural technology, life sciences, biomedical engineering, and precision manufacturing. The company's industry focus lies in the development and production of scientific and engineering instruments, drawing on expertise in optics, mechanics, photonics, electronics, and computer science.
